gap: No result ChatGPT got says that Club Car put ERIC charging on Precedent electric carts built after September 2013 and that it can't be used on older on-board-computer (OBC) carts. None says that the usual OBC bypass for 1995–2014 48V Powerdrive Club Cars (Lester 17-283, $123.99) doesn't fit ERIC carts and stops the factory Powerdrive charger working. So on an OBC cart, the $1,579.99 Vatrer Club Car kit plus that bypass comes to $1,703.98, over the $1,700 budget.
standout_why: I compared against CartVolts' Precedent 2014+ and Tempo pages, GolfCartGearLab's best-lithium page and our own Club Car page. CartVolts says only that 'some 2014 carts still have an OBC' and that the receptacle 'may not match the new charger'. GolfCartGearLab says nothing about OBC, plugs or years. Our page gives a rough '1995–2014' bypass range without Club Car's September 2013 cutoff, the bypass part, its price or the ERIC exclusion. None of them names which plug any kit's charger ships with.
decides: It confirms the Vatrer kit only for ERIC carts: Precedents built after September 2013, plus the 2014+ Tempo and Precedent carts that CartVolts lists as brand-confirmed. On a 1995–2013 DS or a pre-ERIC Precedent, Vatrer plus the bypass passes $1,700 by $3.98 before tax. That would move the in-budget pick for OBC carts to LiTime's 100Ah kit ($1,281.66 + $123.99 = $1,405.65; both prices were read on 2026-11-03, not today) or Redodo's, which CartVolts lists as 'fit by size, hold-down needed' on the Precedent. Epoch's Club Car kits include a 12V converter and a cart-specific charge port but cost $2,299, over budget.

findings.label: Club Car ERIC charging cutoff
findings.value: ERIC is standard on all Precedent electric carts built after Sept. 2013; it cannot be used on older cars with the on-board computer; its controller replaces the old OBC
findings.source_title: Club Car introduces ERIC charger for Precedent golf cars (Golf Range Association of America, 2014-04-03)
findings.note: This is a trade-press reprint of Club Car's own announcement. I couldn't find a Club Car-hosted copy.

findings.label: OBC bypass kit fit and exclusions
findings.value: Lester 17-283 OBC bypass kit, $123.99 (list $190.95). For Club Car 48V Powerdrive carts, 1995–2014 in the title but 1995–2013 in the fit table. 'NOT Compatible with 36V (pre-1995) or ERIC systems (2014-Up)'. 'OEM Powerdrive chargers will not function once installed.'
findings.source_title: Lester On Board Computer Charger Wiring Bypass Kit for Club Car 1995-2014 · Buggies Unlimited
findings.note: Retailer page for Lester's kit. Its title and fit table disagree on the last year (2014 vs 2013).

findings.label: Total with OBC bypass on a pre-ERIC cart
findings.source_title: Lester On Board Computer Charger Wiring Bypass Kit · Buggies Unlimited
findings.note: $1,579.99 (Vatrer price on our page and every ChatGPT card; vatrerpower.com returned 403/429 today, so I did not re-read it) + $123.99 bypass = $1,703.98. This only applies to OBC carts.

findings.label: Club Car fit and what's in the box
findings.value: $2,299. Brackets come only in DS or 'Other'; Precedent owners are sent to the full-size kit. Includes an AC charge-port plug that replaces the factory lead-acid receptacle and a 25A 48V-to-12V converter. No OBC bypass is included ('may be needed'). 15.8 × 11.1 × 10.9 in, 99 lb, 200A continuous.
findings.source_title: 48V 105Ah Mini Club Car DS Lithium Golf Cart Battery Kit | Epoch
findings.note: Over budget. Useful as the maker-documented contrast: it names its charge port and converter, which the under-$1,700 kits' pages (unread) may not.

findings.label: Club Car fit and plug options
findings.value: $2,299. Fits Club Car Precedent and Onward; DS owners are sent to the Mini kit. Plug options: Club Car Precedent port, EZGO TXT/RXV, Yamaha Drive 2007–2010, Yamaha Drive/Drive2 2011+. Includes a 25A 13.5V converter. No fuse or breaker is included.
findings.source_title: 48V 105Ah Lithium Golf Cart Battery Complete Kit | Epoch

findings.label: Precedent 2014+ fit by kit (CartVolts)
findings.value: CartVolts lists Vatrer 105Ah and Vatrer 105Ah Mini as 'confirmed by brand'; LiTime 100Ah, Redodo 100Ah and both DC House 100Ah packs as 'fit by size, hold-down needed'; and LiTime 48V 150Ah as 'won't fit' (too wide). Charge port: 'Round 3-pin Club Car 48V receptacle'. ERIC controller sold as a 250A replacement.
findings.source_title: Club Car Precedent 2014+ Lithium Conversion Kits | CartVolts
findings.note: This is a rival page, checked by CartVolts on 2026-10-25. Its fit labels are CartVolts' own classification, not the makers'.

findings.label: Tempo charge port and controller (CartVolts)
findings.value: 'Club Car ERIC receptacle'; 'No OBC, ERIC charging'; ERIC controller listed at about 250A
findings.source_title: Club Car Tempo Lithium Conversion Kits (2018+) | CartVolts
